title: Alinea Invest — Can AI Invest for You? What Allie Can and Can't Do
summary: Debunk the myth of passive AI! Alinea Invest's AI investing companion, Allie, thinks and acts for your financial future. Explore our product updates.
body_markdown:
AI in investing can mean many things. This article explains what Allie, Alinea’s AI assistant, does, what it does not do, and where AI plays a larger role in the app. All investing involves risk, including loss of principal.


**What Allie Is**


Allie is Alinea’s built-in AI assistant, with its own tab in the app. It helps you understand your account, learn about investing, and take actions in the app through conversation. Allie is not a financial advisor. It does not manage your portfolio, and it does not tell you what to buy or sell.


**What Allie Can Do**


- Answer questions about your holdings, balances, and performance across your account types.
- Look up stock prices, charts, and historical returns. Every historical performance statement includes a past-performance disclosure.
- Share market briefings and daily lessons, and explain financial topics in plain language.
- At your request, start a deposit, withdrawal, buy, or sell. You confirm every transaction before it runs, and Allie never moves money on its own.
- Create a Vibe Investing Playlist when you ask, using a short set of questions about your theme, stocks to include, and risk preference.


**What Allie Does Not Do**


- Allie does not give buy or sell directives, price predictions, or tax or legal advice.
- Allie does not adjust your Automated Investing portfolio. That portfolio is assigned by algorithm from your questionnaire answers and rebalanced monthly.
- Allie stays on topic: money and Alinea.


**How Allie Works**


Allie is a large language model connected to tools that fetch your real portfolio data, live market data, and news. Facts it states come from those tools in the conversation, not from the model’s memory. Even so, AI-generated information can rely on data that is inaccurate, incomplete, or out of date, and it can be faulty or even made up \[1\]. Allie can make mistakes.


**Where AI Does Set Investment Weights**


AI plays a larger role in two parts of the app. Vibe Investing Playlists are created and rebalanced monthly by an AI model, and Alinea’s researcher Playlists are rebalanced weekly by an AI model. In both cases the weights are set by AI with no human review. When the model changes the weights, Alinea generates a report explaining why, with citations to its sources. AI-set weights can be wrong, and these Playlists may be less diversified and more volatile.


**Evaluating AI Investing Tools**


Regulators advise investors to be wary of claims, even from registered firms, that AI can guarantee investment returns, and to avoid relying solely on AI-generated information when making investment decisions \[1\]. When you evaluate any AI investing tool, ask what it does and does not do, who makes the final decision, what its limitations are, and what it costs.

**Frequently Asked Questions**


**Does Allie invest for me?**


No. Allie can start a transaction at your request, but you confirm every transaction before it runs. Allie does not decide what you buy or sell.


**Does Allie give investment advice?**


No. Allie provides educational research and feedback only. It does not provide investment advice or recommendations.


**Is Allie suitable for new investors?**


Allie is designed to explain investing concepts and your account in plain language. Investing involves risk, and Allie’s responses can be inaccurate, so consider your own goals and risk tolerance.


**How is Alinea’s Automated Investing different from a Playlist created by AI?**


Automated Investing assigns you one of four risk-based model portfolios of ETFs by algorithm, based on your questionnaire answers, and rebalances it monthly. Vibe Investing and researcher Playlists are collections of stocks whose weights are set by an AI model.
